messages:
rachel: quick heads-up  release for sample-sdk blocked at publish. regendiff shows only a reorder in generated types but our publish guard treats any regendiff as fatal.

ci-bot: CI: release/sample-sdk #912 failed  regendiff detected in packages/sample-sdk/src/gen/types.ts

kyle: paste from regendiff:
```
- export interface Workspace { id: string; owner?: string; name?: string }
+ export interface Workspace { name?: string; owner?: string; id: string }
```

sophia: this looks like the same nondeterministic property ordering we saw in other repos. Could be a codegen patch or the way optional props are emitted.

rachel: immediate unblock options? revert generated commit, or push a normalizer to CI that stable-sorts keys post-regen.

kyle: fastest is a tiny PR that runs a normalize step in prepublish CI and pins @redwood/codegen to the version used for the last successful publish. I'll open it.

eng-ml: long-term fix tracked in INF-2410: add deterministic key ordering pass in typegen. Also propose a release-stamp rule change: if regendiff affects only generated files and diffs match ordering/whitespace/header-only patterns, allow publish to proceed if regen-idempotency and compatibility-suite pass. Product must approve for transparency.

sophia: can we also add a regen-smoke job that runs regen twice in CI to catch nondet behavior before PRs merge? That prevented a lot of last-minute issues.

kyle: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-sdk/pull/912  adds scripts/normalize-gen.js, CI job regen-idempotency, pins @redwood/codegen@3.7.5. Includes a short PR note explaining nondeterminism.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #912.

rachel: tiny ask: include a changelog note in the PR describing this as "chore(gen): normalize generated types to avoid regendiff noise" for auditability. We don't want to hide that a regen happened.

kyle: added changelog line and PR description.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #912.

sophia: merging now. After merge, re-run release pipeline.

ci-bot: CI: release retried  publish step reached. No regendiff found. Publish succeeded: sample-sdk v0.4.1.

rachel: follow-ups: 1) RFC INF-2410 to add deterministic ordering in typegen (owners: eng-ml + devex), 2) change proposal for release-stamp heuristics (eng-infra + product), 3) audit repos for codegen pins.

kyle: I'll file the audit ticket and link the PR.

eng-ml: noted. We'll prioritize deterministic pass in the next sprint.

rachel: thanks team  closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
